name: claude-mods
description: Mods and skills for Claude Code. The mods carry the shared Mods sidebar: install any one, and every installed one gets a section there.

plugins.name: cherrypick
plugins.description: Copy any part of a Claude reply: one paragraph, quote, code block or heading without its markdown markers, or several sections checked and copied together.

plugins.name: whereabouts
plugins.description: Where this Claude Code conversation lives: its transcript path, folder, session ID, working directory, branch and model, each one click to copy, in the Mods sidebar or with /transcript.

plugins.name: cleanup
plugins.description: A /cleanup skill that keeps AI slop out of PRs: it trims comments to the ones that carry a why, matches the codebase's comment conventions, and puts constants and types before the code that uses them. A commit hook runs it on everything Claude commits.
